priorityList: Cast Haunt if you have fewer than 2 stacks of Nightfall.
Cast Seed of Corruption if Corruption is not ticking or is about to expire on your main target.
Maintain Agony on up to 5 targets, prioritizing those with less than 5 seconds remaining.
Spend Soul Shards on Seed of Corruption if you have the Sow the Seeds talent.
Spend Soul Shards on Unstable Affliction if Sow the Seeds is not talented.
Use Nightfall procs via Drain Soul (or Shadow Bolt) if you are at max stacks (2) or the buff is about to expire.
Refresh Agony on targets if the remaining duration is less than 50% of its total duration.
Cast Malefic Grasp (if talented) while Darkglare is active to maximize its benefit.
Use Drain Soul (or Shadow Bolt) as your primary filler when no other high-priority actions are available.
Use combat potions and racial abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury) whenever Darkglare is active.
In pre-combat, ensure your pet is summoned and pre-cast Seed of Corruption to spread dots instantly.
